What pass requires: The lesson states what learners will do, what evidence they will produce, and the success criteria.
At least one assessment requires observable cybersecurity work rather than recall alone.
Modeling and guided practice prepare learners for the independent performance without completing it for them.
Support profiles change scaffolding rather than replacing the target competency with an easier outcome.
The instructor guide includes setup, facilitation, misconceptions or likely difficulties, expected evidence, and troubleshooting.
The packet provides a viable low-technology or accessibility alternative when tool or interface access could exclude learners.
